claims.text:
stage computation: Linear encoder z=(x0+x1)/2, decoder(z)=(z,z). Family inputs (t,t), t∈{−1,0,1}, reconstruct exactly using1 scalar code instead of2 input coordinates. For each show x→z→reconstruction and sum squared reconstruction error.

**Countercase / boundary:** Off-family input(1,−1) maps toz0 and reconstruction(0,0), error2. Also(−1,1) shares code0, proving this encoder loses distinguishing information. Identity2-coordinate code reconstructs both families exactly. One-dimensional code alone does not force useful semantics or prevent memorization of a finite dataset with other architectures.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict reconstruction of(1,−1); recall input(2,2) still reconstructs exactly, while(2,−2) gives error8 under this fixed encoder.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Encode/Decode reveals the information path, then Off family and Identity code compare actual dimensions/errors with retained primary exact-copy witness. Do not label the manually specified weights trained.
